shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The system has no shadows. Structure is drawn with 1px hairline borders and the neutral stack; the modal uses a hairline border over a dimmed (not blurred) backdrop.

motion.name: spin

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single loudest action on a screen — solid foreground fill, background-colored ink, square, uppercase.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #0d0d0d; background: #ededed; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #c4c4c4; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #c4c4c4; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action — transparent with a strong hairline edge, square.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #c4c4c4; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #3d3d3d; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #222222; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action — the only colored control. Transparent with a danger border, inverts to a danger fill on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #d8593f; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #d8593f; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #d8593f; color: #0d0d0d; }

components.name: Badge (neutral & danger)
components.description: Monochrome by default — platform tags, statuses, transition classes and risk levels all use neutral. Danger is the only colored badge.
components.html: Mix sicuro Buon reset Errore
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; border-radius: 0; } .ds-badge-neutral { color: #787878; background: #222222; } .ds-badge-danger { color: #d8593f; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #d8593f; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Surface layer off the floor — hairline border, no shadow, no radius.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #161616; border: 1px solid #2b2b2b; border-radius: 0; padding: 16px; } .ds-card-label { font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: #787878; } .ds-card-value { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #ededed; }

components.name: Search / Filter Input
components.description: Inset field — darker than its surface, square, foreground focus ring, no layout shift.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 0.875rem; color: #c4c4c4; background: #0d0d0d; border: 1px solid #2b2b2b; border-radius: 0; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #555555; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #3d3d3d; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #c4c4c4; }

components.name: INDEX Nav Item
components.description: Editorial nav — uppercase mono links; active = underlined foreground text. No icons, no fill.
components.html: DashboardLibreriaPlaylist
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 180px; padding: 16px; background: #0d0d0d; } .ds-nav-item { padding: 4px 0; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #787878; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #c4c4c4; } .ds-nav-active { color: #ededed; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Coverage Bar
components.description: Library completeness readout — square track on elevated, foreground fill, tabular n/total counts.

narrative.overview: SetArc reads like a printed catalogue of a record library. The interface is monospace throughout, laid out on a hairline grid, square, and almost monochrome — ink on a near-black field by default, or on warm paper when toggled. Density is editorial, not dashboard-like: dense columns of type, numbered lists, uppercase section labels, tabular figures aligned like a typeset index. Structure is drawn with 1px hairlines and the neutral stack, never with shadows or rounded cards. The only hue is a single restrained red for errors and destructive actions; everything else, including Camelot keys and mix-status, is monochrome.
keyCharacteristics: Monospace (IBM Plex Mono) for the entire interface — chrome, labels, body, and data
Hairline three-zone editorial shell: INDEX / CONTENT / MARGINALIA
Square geometry everywhere (radius 0), no shadows except a dimmed modal backdrop
Near-monochrome: one red (danger) only, for errors and destructive actions
Two runtime themes — dark (default) and warm paper — persisted, no FOUC

rules.name: The Monochrome Rule
rules.body: Nothing carries hue except danger. Camelot keys, mix-status, transition quality and risk levels are rendered in neutrals — distinguished by weight, uppercase labels, and position, never by color.

rules.name: The One-Red Rule
rules.body: Red means error or destruction, full stop. A low score or a risky transition is not an error and must stay monochrome.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number a DJ scans is set in tabular figures (.tnum) so columns align like a typeset index.

rules.name: The Mono Rule
rules.body: One monospace family for the entire UI. No serif headlines, no second sans for contrast. Hierarchy is weight, size, case, and tracking.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px borders and the neutral stack. If a region needs separating, add a filet or step the stack — never a shadow, never a radius.

dos: Do keep the entire UI monospace; hierarchy is weight, case, and tracking.
Do draw structure with 1px hairlines and the neutral stack — flat, square, no shadows.
Do set every metric in tabular figures via .tnum.
Do render Camelot keys, mix-status, and quality/risk in monochrome.
Do keep both themes in sync — every surface must read in dark and paper.
Do use uppercase tracked labels for column/section headers and field labels.
donts: Don't introduce any color other than danger, and only for errors/destruction.
Don't add rounded corners or shadows — radius 0, hairlines only (The Hairline Rule).
Don't color-code keys or mix quality (The Monochrome Rule).
Don't introduce a second type family or a non-mono face in UI chrome (The Mono Rule).
Don't treat a low score or risky transition as an error — keep it monochrome (The One-Red Rule).
Don't put faint on anything that must be read at body size; use muted for readable secondary text.
